definitions.gloss: wild boar hot pot; boar meat simmered in a pot
definitions.explanation: A winter {鍋|なべ} dish of thinly sliced wild boar meat simmered with vegetables in a miso or soy-based broth. A regional speciality of mountain areas, especially {丹波|たんば} in Hyogo Prefecture.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{牡丹鍋|ぼたんなべ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧だ。
examples.english: In winter I look forward to wild boar hot pot.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{宿|やど}→宿：03641_yado⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{牡丹鍋|ぼたんなべ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: We ate wild boar hot pot at an inn in the mountains.

examples.japanese: ⟦{味噌|みそ}→味噌：01037_miso⟧{仕立|じた}て⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{牡丹鍋|ぼたんなべ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{猪|いのしし}{肉|にく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{臭|くさ}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{消|き}えて→消える：02520_kieru⟧⟦{食|た}べやすい→食べやすい：21799_tabeyasui⟧。
examples.english: Miso-based wild boar hot pot loses the gaminess of the boar meat and is easy to eat.

notes:
Named for the way the sliced boar meat is arranged on the plate like the petals of a ⟦{牡丹|ぼたん}→牡丹：13488_botan⟧ (peony). Part of an old set of flower names for game meat, used when eating meat was officially discouraged.

GAME-MEAT FLOWER NAMES:
- ⟦{牡丹|ぼたん}→牡丹：13488_botan⟧: wild boar (⟦{猪|いのしし}→猪：04349_inoshishi⟧)
- もみじ: deer (⟦{鹿|しか}→鹿：04347_shika⟧)
- さくら: horse (⟦{馬|うま}→馬：01865_uma⟧)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {牡丹鍋|ぼたんなべ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧: to eat wild boar hot pot
- ⟦{味噌|みそ}→味噌：01037_miso⟧{仕立|じた}て⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{牡丹鍋|ぼたんなべ}: miso-based boar hot pot
- {牡丹鍋|ぼたんなべ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧: boar hot pot season

SIMILAR WORDS:
- しし⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧: boar hot pot — the plainer name for the same dish
- もみじ⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧: venison hot pot — the deer counterpart
